name: iVest donation-on-burn double debit
summary: The iVest token treats a transfer to the zero address as a burn donation charged to msg.sender, on top of the transfer itself. Skimming the iVest/WBNB pair to address(0) made the pair pay the donation from its own balance, so repeated skim(0) and sync calls burned the pair's iVest reserve and the attacker sold iVest into the pool for its WBNB.
notes: The zero-address donation path is in the deployed transfer code; the token's later storage changes before the exploit are balances and reflection totals only.

Loss is the WBNB the iVest/WBNB pair lost per transaction, net of WBNB swapped in within the same transaction, across the anchor and seven later skim(address(0)) copycats from other senders; the iVest burned from the pair is the mechanism, not counted separately.
